titel: Smoky wraps with vegetarian mince and vegetables
stappen: Fry the sweet potato in 2 tbsp oil for 12–15 min with the lid on, over medium-high heat. Stir regularly. Set aside.
Fry the onion, leek, pepper and green beans in 1 tbsp oil (8 min). Add the garlic for the last minute.
Push the vegetables to one side and fry the mince. Add the tomato purée and spices and fry until the mince browns.
Stir in the passata and sugar. Simmer uncovered until the sauce is thick.
Stir in the kidney beans, sweetcorn and sweet potato and heat for 3 min. Season with lime juice and salt.
Warm the wraps briefly. Top with the filling, a spoonful of crème fraîche and chipotle. Roll up.
tips: Keep the sauce mild, as the chipotle already adds heat and smokiness.
More depth: add a splash of adobo sauce from the chipotle tin to the sauce.
Leftover filling keeps for 3 days in the fridge and can be frozen.
